mapper.sql: SELECT h.*, p.title AS place_title, p.address AS place_address, p.thumbnail AS place_thumbnail FROM hotel_profiles h JOIN places p ON p.id = h.place_id
SELECT b.*, p.title AS hotel_name FROM hotel_bookings b JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.id = b.hotel_id JOIN places p ON p.id = h.place_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hotel_profiles (id, organization_id, place_id, property_code, property_type, star_rating, description, check_in_time, check_out_time, timezone, amenities, policies, booking_contact, status, disabled_reason, data_version, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{placeId}, #{propertyCode}, #{propertyType}, #{starRating}, #{description}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{timezone}, #{amenities}::jsonb, #{policies}::jsonb, #{bookingContact}::jsonb, #{status}, #{disabledReason}, #{dataVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE hotel_profiles SET property_code=#{propertyCode}, property_type=#{propertyType}, star_rating=#{starRating}, description=#{description}, check_in_time=#{checkInTime}, check_out_time=#{checkOutTime}, timezone=#{timezone}, amenities=#{amenities}::jsonb, policies=#{policies}::jsonb, booking_contact=#{bookingContact}::jsonb, status=#{status}, disabled_reason=#{disabledReason}, data_version=data_version+1, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND data_version=#{dataVersion}
mapper.select: WHERE h.organization_id=#{organizationId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM room_types WHERE hotel_id=#{hotelId} AND status='ENABLED' ORDER BY created_at
SELECT * FROM rate_plans WHERE room_type_id=#{roomTypeId} AND status='ENABLED' ORDER BY created_at
mapper.insert: WITH dates AS (SELECT generate_series(#{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, interval '1 day')::date AS day) INSERT INTO room_inventory_daily (room_type_id,inventory_date,total_units,reserved_units,sold_units,blocked_units, stop_sell,price_override,min_stay,closed_to_arrival,closed_to_departure,data_version,updated_by,updated_at) SELECT r.id,d.day,COALESCE(#{totalUnits},r.total_units),0,0,COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},0),COALESCE(#{stopSell},false), #{priceOverride},#{minStay},COALESCE(#{closedToArrival},false),COALESCE(#{closedToDeparture},false),1,#{updatedBy},#{updatedAt} FROM room_types r CROSS JOIN dates d WHERE r.id=#{roomTypeId} ON CONFLICT (room_type_id,inventory_date) DO UPDATE SET total_units=COALESCE(#{totalUnits},room_inventory_daily.total_units), blocked_units=COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},room_inventory_daily.blocked_units), stop_sell=COALESCE(#{stopSell},room_inventory_daily.stop_sell), price_override=COALESCE(#{priceOverride},room_inventory_daily.price_override), min_stay=COALESCE(#{minStay},room_inventory_daily.min_stay), closed_to_arrival=COALESCE(#{closedToArrival},room_inventory_daily.closed_to_arrival), closed_to_departure=COALESCE(#{closedToDeparture},room_inventory_daily.closed_to_departure), data_version=room_inventory_daily.data_version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE room_inventory_daily.reserved_units + room_inventory_daily.sold_units + COALESCE(#{blockedUnits},room_inventory_daily.blocked_units) <= COALESCE(#{totalUnits},room_inventory_daily.total_units)
mapper.select: SELECT i.inventory_date,(i.total_units-i.reserved_units-i.sold_units-i.blocked_units) AS available_units, i.stop_sell,i.closed_to_arrival,i.closed_to_departure,COALESCE(i.min_stay,rp.min_stay) AS min_stay, COALESCE(i.price_override,rp.base_price) AS nightly_price,rp.currency FROM room_inventory_daily i JOIN room_types r ON r.id=i.room_type_id JOIN rate_plans rp ON rp.id=#{ratePlanId} AND rp.room_type_id=r.id JOIN hotel_profiles h ON h.id=r.hotel_id WHERE h.id=#{hotelId} AND r.id=#{roomTypeId} AND h.status='ENABLED' AND r.status='ENABLED' AND rp.status='ENABLED' AND i.inventory_date >=#{checkIn} AND i.inventory_date <#{checkOut} ORDER BY i.inventory_date

SELECT i.*,r.name AS room_type_name,rp.name AS rate_plan_name FROM hotel_booking_items i JOIN room_types r ON r.id=i.room_type_id JOIN rate_plans rp ON rp.id=i.rate_plan_id WHERE i.booking_id=#{bookingId}
WHERE b.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
